arms.difference: ONLY the pory2 field (and the name). Checked by deleting name and pory2 from both specs and comparing: identical. Both: gen5 MAG/DODUO, k 4x4, depth 0, 1 reserved switch row, budgetMs 5000 cap, adaptive { targetMs 14000, credit0Ms 4667 } = the clock of the piKL SPRT (1.50.0).

path_choice.rule_from_the_brief: If a 14 s SPRT at 2,000 games would take more than about 30 h, run the pre-registered 200-game not-lose screen at 14 s first (the same 100 test pairs, pair-seed 1), and continue to the SPRT only if the screen's point score is >= 0.5.
path_choice.estimate: the 14 s piKL SPRT (1.50.0) took 23,104 s for 428 games played on 3 workers = 54.0 s a game; 2,000 games = 108,000 s = 30.0 h before the games played past the stop. Its pre-registration estimated 'up to about 31 h'. The 14 s screen took 8,440 s for 200 games on 4 workers (42 s a game, ~56 s a game on 3).
path_choice.decision: SCREEN FIRST. The worst case is at or just over 30 h, and v2's evidence so far points the other way (gate (a) failed; H0 at 1 s). This is a judgement at the line and is stated as one.

screen.command: node solver/machamp/gate.js (through tools\lownode.cmd, BELOWNORMAL) --release eaa5becc54eb --x solver/results/2026-10-01-v2-14s-rolev1/gen5-p2v2-adaptive-14s.json --y solver/results/2026-09-30-human-regularised/screen-14s-off.json --pairs 100 --pair-seed 1 --seed 31001 --workers 4 --cap 50 --rule notlose --info honest --spreads role-v1 --team-store C:/Users/willj/Projects/Pokemon/ABRA/data/team-pool-frozen-regmc --out solver/out/v2-14s-rolev1/screen-14s-p2v2.json
screen.seed_note: NEW: 31001 appears as a seed nowhere else in solver/ or docs/_reports/.
screen.read: ONCE at 200 games. Reported: score with Wilson 95%, gate.js notlose verdict, paired view, clock ratio = decision_ms.x.mean / decision_ms.y.mean, the v2 leaf counters (summed over each shard's last line: ctr.leaf_own['porygon2-v2-k1.json'].evals vs ctr.leaf_by_model['porygon2-v2-k1.json'], errors; ctr.leaf_by_model['porygon2-gen5.json']), fallbacks, warnings, the spreads block.
screen.continue_rule: Continue to the SPRT iff ALL of: (1) the screen's point score of X >= 0.5 (the brief's rule; stricter than gate.js notlose); (2) clock ratio <= 1.10; (3) the v2 leaf proved it ran (evals > 0, = calls, errors 0, and gen5's net > 0). (2) or (3) false = the screen is VOID and is reported, not re-read. A screen is a license, not a strength claim.
screen.on_stop: If the screen does not license the SPRT, Run 1 ends at the screen. The verdict is 'not continued to SPRT', with the score; no strength claim either way.

sprt.command: node solver/machamp/sprt.js (through tools\lownode.cmd, BELOWNORMAL) --release eaa5becc54eb --x solver/results/2026-10-01-v2-14s-rolev1/gen5-p2v2-adaptive-14s.json --y solver/results/2026-09-30-human-regularised/screen-14s-off.json --elo0 0 --elo1 20 --alpha 0.05 --beta 0.05 --max-games 2000 --seed 31002 --workers 3 --cap 50 --info honest --spreads role-v1 --team-store C:/Users/willj/Projects/Pokemon/ABRA/data/team-pool-frozen-regmc --out solver/out/v2-14s-rolev1/sprt-14s-p2v2.json
sprt.unit: pair of games on one battle seed, seats swapped; normal-approximation GSPRT on pair scores, pair-index order
sprt.seed_note: NEW, and different from the screen's so the SPRT's games are not the screen's games.

reading_rule.when: ONCE, after sprt.js stops (a bound crossed or the game budget spent). sprt.js prints no interim LLR. A run stopped by anything else (a pause, a crash, a kill) is VOID and is re-run from this file with the same seed.
reading_rule.verdict: H1 (X stronger by elo1 accepted), H0, or INCONCLUSIVE (2,000 games, no bound).
reading_rule.clock: solver/machamp/sprt_read.js: clock ratio = clock.x_ms.mean / clock.y_ms.mean over counted games; must be <= 1.10. Above 1.10 an H1 is VOID-BY-CLOCK, not a strength claim.
reading_rule.capability: as the screen's (3), summed over each worker's last shard line. Any false = VOID.
reading_rule.errors: errored pairs excluded by sprt.js and counted; VOID if over 5% of the pairs used. Fallbacks stated.
reading_rule.also_read_not_bars: per-arm leaf calls; Protect counters (solver/arena/protect_read.js); ladder clock-rule breaches (55 s per turn, 420 s bank).
reading_rule.ci_caption: the Wilson 95% interval at the stop is conditional on a data-dependent stopping time and slightly optimistic.

order: Run 1 (screen, then the SPRT if licensed) first, then Run 2 (solver/results/2026-10-01-rolev1-baselines/preregistration.json). One game-playing job at a time.
on_H1: report only. v2 goes onto no ladder arm and no league default; that is Will's call. An H1 does not retro-pass gate (a).
on_H0_or_inconclusive_or_screen_stop: report only; v2 stays off every arm.
